title: Introduction to Arduino Workshop
description: Learn the basics of Arduino programming and build your first IoT project.
longDescription: Join us for a hands-on workshop where you'll learn Arduino fundamentals, circuit design, and programming. Perfect for beginners! We'll cover basic electronics, sensors, actuators, and how to create your own IoT projects.

title: IEEE Day Celebration 2023
description: Celebrating IEEE Day with fun activities, competitions, and networking.
longDescription: Join us in celebrating IEEE Day! The event featured tech talks, competitions, networking sessions, and fun activities. It was a great opportunity to connect with fellow IEEE members and learn about the impact of IEEE worldwide.

title: Python Programming Bootcamp
description: Intensive Python bootcamp for beginners covering fundamentals to advanced topics.
longDescription: A comprehensive Python programming bootcamp designed for beginners. Learn Python fundamentals, data structures, object-oriented programming, and practical applications. Includes hands-on projects and real-world examples.
